mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN ci.status = 'valid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS validCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ci.status = 'expired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expiredCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ci.status = 'used' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS usedCount, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.id) AS strategyCount FROM cert_info ci LEFT JOIN cert_strategy cs ON ci.strategy_id = cs.id
